execution: Materialize initial_files in isolated projects. Run with the skill and a no-skill baseline from identical inputs. After each run, use a fresh executor with only the resulting project and the same request; compare bytes for needless churn. Capture reports outside the project, not as permanent project documents.

evals.name: existing-project-with-published-contract
evals.prompt: 整理本项目上下文与文档，允许更新项目级 AGENTS.md，但不改代码、数据或运行配置。当前 checkout 的已确认行为是打印 hello；生产发布仍为 v1，发布文档与原始审计材料必须保留。产品没有未完成需求，不需要新设计。清理重复、过时和已完成记录，让新会话能找到当前契约和安全验证方法。

initial_files.AGENTS.md:
# Project instructions

Use README.md as the project entry. Do not mutate application data or deployed-release records when editing docs.
initial_files.README.md:
# Greeter

Current checkout prints hello via python3 app.py. It has not been deployed. Current contract: [API](docs/api.md). Published v1: [release](docs/release-v1.md).
initial_files.docs/api.md:
# Current contract

The checkout prints goodbye.
initial_files.docs/feature-api.md:
# Greeter feature

The checkout prints hello. This duplicates the current API responsibility.
initial_files.docs/tasks/greeter.md:
# Greeter task

Status: completed. Current checkout prints hello. No pending product work. The only long-term fact belongs to the API contract.
initial_files.docs/check.md:
# Run diary

Session 1: edited greeting. Session 2: python3 app.py printed hello. This is routine historical output with no retention requirement.
initial_files.docs/release-v1.md:
# Published v1

v1 prints goodbye. Consumers still use this published release; keep this contract until release support ends.
initial_files.audit/receipt.txt: Required immutable release receipt: v1, original count 8.

evals.expected_output: A single current contract describes hello; published v1 and protected bytes remain intact. Completed task and redundant narratives leave current context. No speculative scaffold or setup is introduced.
assertions: Code, user data, published release and audit receipt remain byte-identical.
One current contract agrees with hello and checkout is not called deployed.
Completed task and duplicate feature authority are removed without a new archive/report collection.
Current entry links resolve and a fresh reader can identify the safe CLI command.
Fresh repeated execution leaves an adequate project unchanged.

evals.name: new-project-with-unresolved-stack
evals.prompt: 为新项目建立最小上下文。目标是离线检查用户提供的 CSV，输出无效行的位置，不上传数据。技术栈、CLI 形状和错误规则尚未决定，不要替我选择，也不写代码。允许创建 README.md 和项目级 AGENTS.md；本项目明确使用 AGENTS.md 作为人工与 Agent 阅读入口，无需宣称任何运行时自动加载。保存下一轮 grill-design 所需的真实问题，不要先运行其他工作流。
evals.expected_output: Confirmed goal and offline constraint are saved, undecided choices stay pending, and a real design handoff exists without imaginary architecture or executable commands.
assertions: No implementation, dependency/tool configuration or invented run/build command is created.
Confirmed offline scope is distinguished from unresolved stack, CLI and error decisions.
No empty architecture, ADR, index, evidence or parallel instruction-file scaffold is generated.
A fresh reader can locate the next design question without prior conversation.
Fresh repeated execution leaves an adequate project unchanged.
